features.name: agent_log_tap_mean
features.rationale: A nonlinear monotonic interval representation may be more appropriate than adding many interactions.

features.name: agent_log_tap_rate
features.rationale: Compress high rates instead of adding a second interval variability ratio.

features.name: agent_tap_standardized_tail
features.rationale: Distinguish extreme pauses relative to within-task interval scale.

features.name: agent_tap_nonalt_rate
features.rationale: Rate of nonalternating valid events, retaining compatible dimensions.

features.name: agent_log_tap_tail_ratio
features.rationale: Round-one tail ratio was weak; bound its leverage with a logarithm.

features.name: agent_log_shimmer_long
features.rationale: Long-window shimmer showed a modest discovery association; compress outliers.

features.name: agent_shimmer_scale_ratio
features.rationale: Relative long/short perturbation may separate scale from total perturbation.

features.name: agent_tap_voice_logmean
features.rationale: One revised interaction between typical timing and long-window amplitude perturbation, rather than the unsuccessful large bundle.
